description:

description:
**Description**
Amazon.com is looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Digital Content Platform team. The Digital Acceleration Commerce team owns services supporting the publishing, pricing and purchase of Digital content, including Kindle Books, Amazon AppStore, Amazon Music, Amazon Video, etc.
  
  
This candidate will be joining a team working on scalable web services using cloud technologies. The work will be highly visible to Amazon customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, this person will lead the architecture and development of high-scale web services and workflows. A successful candidate will have an established background in designing and developing back-end web services, strong technical skills, a motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced environment, high creativity, and great analytical reasoning skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer III (SDE3) on the Digital Pricing and Promotions team, you will design and build software solutions that power promotional capabilities across Amazon's Digital Acceleration (DA) businesses — including Kindle, Prime Video, and Music. You will own and evolve critical platforms that deliver promotional management, competitive pricing intelligence, and operational automation to pricing managers, business teams, and product managers across DA.
  
  
You will take meaningful ownership of key products — particularly the Promos UI platform — driving features from initial design through deployment and ongoing maintenance. Your work will span full-stack development: crafting user interfaces with modern web technologies, building robust backend services in Java on AWS, and integrating with Retail promotion systems such as PLM (Promotion Lifecycle Management).
  
  
In this role, you will make architectural decisions that balance near-term business needs with long-term scalability and maintainability. You will think across systems — considering performance at scale, multi-business extensibility, and integration with diverse data sources and downstream services. You will lead technical designs independently, engage actively in design reviews, and provide substantive code review feedback that raises the bar for the team.
  
  
Collaboration is central to this role. You will work closely with operations teams, business stakeholders, Retail promotion platform teams, and partner engineering organizations. You will develop a deep understanding of customer workflows and pain points, translating them into well-designed, reliable solutions. You will champion operational excellence through proactive monitoring, incident response, and identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement.
  
  
Beyond individual delivery, you will help grow the team — mentoring junior engineers, contributing to development best practices, and driving technical improvements that increase the team's overall velocity and reliability. Success in this role means consistently shipping high-quality features that advance our promotional capabilities while setting a strong example for engineering craft and customer focus.

* 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Agentic Full-Stack Engineer
description:
**Agentic Full-Stack Engineer**

**About Securin**

Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions — giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do.

**Our Engineering Values**

We build with agents and verify with humans — treating AI as a genuine collaborator, holding agent-generated code to the same review standard as human-authored code, and shipping features only when test coverage and security checks are in place. We take end-to-end ownership, write maintainable code, and bring security awareness into every decision — not as a checkbox, but as a core discipline.

**The Role**

A high-agency software engineer who uses coding agents as a force multiplier: generating design specs with AI, curating those outputs with engineering judgment, and shipping high-quality features at pace on the Securin cybersecurity platform.

**Responsibilities**

● Feature Development

Design and ship full-stack features for the Securin platform end-to-end — using AI coding agents (Claude) to generate specs and boilerplate, then curating those outputs with engineering rigor, security context, and architectural judgment before finalizing. Work with teams in the US and India to facilitate communication, operations, and design. Required to attend 1-2 US evening meetings a week to sync with India based teams.

● Agent & Automation Engineering

Build agentic workflows and automation pipelines that streamline engineering — and enforce a human-in-the-loop review process ensuring every AI-produced change is critically evaluated for correctness, security, and fit before it reaches production.

● Platform & Infrastructure

Architect and maintain cloud-native SaaS services on AWS, contributing to API design, data modeling, and microservices architecture that power real-time threat intelligence ingestion and delivery.

● Security Mindset

Apply secure-by-design principles throughout development and work alongside Securin's security researchers to translate vulnerability intelligence domain knowledge into robust platform capabilities.

**Requirements**

● 3+ years building production SaaS

● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

● Public cloud experience required (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure acceptable)

● Deep familiarity with:

○ Containerization

○ Serverless architecture

○ Event-driven architecture

○ RESTful API design

**Culture-Forward Building with AI: What We Expect - Role-Specific**

○ Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents is a prerequisite.

○ Must be able to critically review agent-generated code and specs for:

● Hallucinations

● Security flaws

● Architectural drift before merging.

**General**

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate

**GenAI tools into daily workflows -**

title: Senior PHY Software Engineer – 2G/4G/5G
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior PHY Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cellular PHY software development, integration, debugging, and system troubleshooting across 2G, 4G, and 5G technologies.
  
  
The role will primarily focus on PHY development, debugging, issue resolution, and integration within our cellular products. As part of our ongoing effort to improve engineering productivity and RCA capabilities, the engineer will also contribute to our AI-assisted development and Root Cause Analysis initiative, helping build and fine-tune AI-based tools/agents for PHY log and crash analysis. The ideal candidate should be a strong PHY domain expert and problem solver, capable of going beyond linear debugging approaches and identifying root causes by correlating evidence across different sources and layers.
  
  
**What you'll do:**

* Design, develop, debug, integrate, and maintain PHY software for cellular communication systems.
* Work across 2G, 4G, and 5G, understanding PHY behavior, implementation, and interaction with the overall system.
* Analyze complex PHY issues using logs, traces, crash dumps, KPIs, configuration, and system behavior to identify root causes.
* Develop and optimize PHY software and algorithms to improve performance, reliability, and product quality.
* Work with existing codebases and repositories, understand implementation flows, and extend or modify them without destabilizing existing functionality.
* Collaborate with MAC, RLC, RRC, RF, DSP, HW, and system teams to resolve complex product and field issues.

**What you should have:**
10+ years of experience in wireless communication / PHY software development, integration, debugging, or system troubleshooting.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience with 4G/LTE and/or 5G NR PHY, with working knowledge of other cellular RATs such as 2G.
  
  
Good understanding of PHY architecture, algorithms, implementation, and interaction with other layers.
  
  
Strong experience in PHY log analysis, debugging, issue isolation, and root-cause analysis, including the ability to identify non-obvious failure mechanisms.
  
  
Ability to correlate logs, traces, configuration, KPIs, and system behavior rather than relying only on predefined or linear debugging procedures.
  
  
Strong C/C++ programming and debugging skills, with good Python/scripting skills for automation and analysis.
  
  
Good understanding of DSP, digital communication, PHY/RF concepts, and relevant 3GPP specifications.
  
  
**AI & Automation – Good to Have:**
Exposure to AI/LLM-based developer tools or coding assistants.
  
  
Interest in applying AI to software development, debugging, log analysis, and RCA.
  
  
Experience with automation, log-processing, or internal debugging/analysis tools.
  
  
Willingness to learn and adopt AI-assisted development and agent-based troubleshooting approaches.
  
  
AI experience is not mandatory. Strong PHY domain expertise, development experience, and troubleshooting ability are the primary requirements.
  
  
Nice to Have:
  
  
Experience across multiple RATs, particularly 2G, 4G, and 5G.
  
  
Experience with O-RAN / Open RAN or advanced 5G PHY features.
  
  
Experience with MATLAB or similar tools for PHY analysis, modeling, or simulation.
  
  
Experience with Linux, Git, ARM, SIMD/NEON/AVX, or optimized DSP implementations.
  
  
Experience with telecom debugging and analysis tools such as Wireshark, Kibana, or similar platforms.
  
  
Role Evolution:
  
  
The initial focus will be on understanding the existing PHY implementation, logs, failure patterns, and troubleshooting methodologies. Over time, the engineer will contribute to building and improving AI-assisted RCA capabilities and use these capabilities as part of regular PHY development, debugging, and bug-fixing activities.
  
  
The objective is to combine deep PHY expertise with AI-assisted engineering to improve debugging efficiency, RCA accuracy, and overall product quality.

title: Cloud Application Modernisation Architect (f/m/d)
description:
What do we do?
  
  
**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**
Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.
  
  
By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.
  
  
What your day will look like
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for two
**Cloud Application Modernisation & Agentic Architects (f/m/d)**
to own the end-to-end refactoring of Thinkproject's application portfolio — 10 applications, 3 of which are major, mission-critical products. You will work as a pair, splitting application ownership between you, and you are expected to move fast: full refactoring across the portfolio within 6–8 months.
  
  
This is not a design-and-delegate role. You will roll up your sleeves, conduct the refactoring hands-on, and manage the project simultaneously. You are both the engineer and the project manager. You will consume the Service Catalog built by the Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect and the networking foundation laid by the GCP & Network Agentic Architect — and turn them into modernised, cloud-native applications that are more reliable, more scalable, fully observable, and cheaper to run.
  
  
**Time allocation (approximate):**
~50% hands-on application refactoring & migration | ~25% project management, planning & stakeholder coordination | ~15% collaboration with DevOps, SecOps, Compliance & SRE | ~10% observability, testing & validation
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Refactoring & Modernisation**

* Own the end-to-end refactoring of your assigned applications — from assessment and design through implementation and validation
* Apply 12-factor app principles, event-driven architecture patterns, and cloud-native design to legacy codebases
* Migrate workloads from on-prem and legacy infrastructure to GCP-native services: Cloud Run, GKE, serverless functions, managed databases, Pub/Sub
* Design for scalability and on-demand resource consumption — cost efficiency is a success metric, not an afterthought
* Use LLM-assisted tooling (Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent) to accelerate refactoring, code modernisation, and IaC generation

**Project Management & Delivery**

* Own the migration plan for your applications: timeline, milestones, dependencies, risks, and rollback strategy
* Track and report progress with precision - this is a time-boxed programme (6–8 months); delays must be surfaced early
* Split application ownership with your paired architect: clear DRI per application, shared standards

**Resilience & Rollback**

* Define and test rollback plans for every application before migration begins - you have crisis experience and you use it
* Handle incidents during migration with calm, methodical rollback and root cause analysis
* Ensure every migrated application meets reliability and observability standards before handover

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with DevOps to integrate migrated applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
* Collaborate with SecOps and Compliance to ensure every migrated application meets security controls and certification requirements
* Engage SRE teams to validate observability, SLO definitions, and alerting coverage post-migration
* Consume and provide feedback on the Service Catalog — you are one of its primary consumers

What you need to fulfill the role
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
You have migrated complex, production applications from on-prem to cloud at scale, under time pressure, and lived to tell the story. Specifically:
  
  

* Proven on-prem to cloud migration experience — at scale, under tight time constraints; you have delivered migrations, not just designed them
* Strong proficiency across both Azure and Google Cloud Platform — networking, infrastructure, and PaaS layers
* Deep hands-on experience with Docker, VMs, GKE and AKS node management, and serverless design patterns (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
* Strong 12-factor app knowledge — you apply it in code, not just reference it in presentations
* Strong event-driven architecture experience — Pub/Sub, event streaming, async decoupling patterns
* Crisis and rollback experience — you have handled production incidents during migrations, executed rollbacks cleanly, and conducted honest post-mortems
* Proven focus on scalability and on-demand resource design — your migrations reduce cost, not just shift it
* Proven hands-on agentic experience: must have used Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent LLM-based coding agents in real engineering workflows
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity — 10 applications, varying legacy states, evolving requirements; you create clarity

**Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Strong cloud networking experience (VPCs, firewall rules, private connectivity)
* FinOps awareness — cost attribution and rightsizing post-migration
* Experience with SecNumCloud or C5 compliance in a migration context
* Prior experience as both engineer and delivery lead on the same programme

**Soft Skills**

* Extreme ownership — you own the outcome for your applications, not just the tasks
* Strong project management discipline: you track details, surface blockers early, and never let a deadline slip silently
* Collaborative by default — you pair well with your counterpart architect and with DevOps, SecOps, SRE, and Compliance
* Crisis-calm: you have been in production incidents during migrations and know how to lead through them
* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and bring relevant innovations into the refactoring programme
* Fact-driven communicator: you report progress with data, not narrative

**What Success Looks Like**

* Month 2: Application portfolio assessed; ownership split agreed with paired architect; migration plan per application documented with milestones, dependencies, and rollback strategy
* Month 4: First 4 applications refactored and in production (2 major + 2 add-on) — observable, scalable, cost-attributed
* Month 6: 7–8 applications fully migrated; third major application on confirmed migration path or complete; observability standard adopted across migrated apps
* Month 8: All 10 applications refactored and live on GCP; full observability in place; reliability and scalability improvements measured and reported; FinOps baseline established per application

Success is defined as: more reliability, more scalability, full observability, lower cost — across all 10 applications.
  
  
**You're probably NOT a fit if**

* You have designed cloud migrations but have not personally executed them in production
* You need a stable architecture foundation before you start — legacy migration means working with what exists
* You are a specialist in one cloud (Azure or GCP) but not both
* You treat project management as someone else's job
* You have not handled a production rollback under pressure

What we offer
  
  

* Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
* Hybrid-first working
* Continuous learning & certification budget
* Open, inclusive, and high-ownership culture
* Learning programmes | Career growth | Leadership access

At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership — not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.
**Hybrid working | Work from abroad | Flexible working hours | Thinkproject Academy | Free English lessons | Unlimited learning | Headspace community access | Women's Network | Corporate volunteering | Social events**
We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.
  
  
**Your Contact**
Mehal Mehta
  
  
**How To Apply**
Submit your application at careers.thinkproject.com, including:
  
  

* Salary expectations
* Potential start date
* A short write-up (max 300 words) on the most complex on-prem to cloud migration you have delivered - what went wrong, how you handled it, and what the outcome was, this is the most important part of your application

* Research and engineer features from raw, high-frequency market data, translating market behavior hypotheses into quantitative signals.

* Developing the utility tools that can further automate the software development, testing and deployment workflow.

* Rigorous quantitative programming skills, with the discipline to write accurate, production-quality, and performance aware code, including low-latency implementations where needed. Prior experience with C++ is a plus.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Amazon Shipping
description:
**Description**
You will build the optimization brain for Amazon's externalized logistics network — a system that couples first-mile route planning with middle-mile network optimization into a joint iterative loop, producing end-to-end recommendations that no single optimizer can reach alone. The technical challenge is real: solvers that take hours per run, a combinatorial search space that defies brute-force, model gaps that require deep-diving into solver internals, and convergence that must be proven across independently owned engines. This is not a scale or latency problem — it's a multi-system optimization convergence problem where you invent the pruning, approximation, and coupling strategies. Your recommendations will directly shape commercial decisions — which shippers to pursue, which geographies to grow, which contracts to reprice — giving this role rare direct business impact for a PE position.
  
  
In addition, you will provide tech leadership to the fulfillment charter for Amazon Shipping where you will be responsible for increasing the label conversion rates that would be a key enabler for revenue growth; identify solutions such as dynamic network capacity management to build a resilient network topology; identify and build speed opportunities in the upstream planning systems; and solve unique challenges related to delivery addresses for an externalized supply chain business where orders are created outside amazon marketplace.
  
  
You will also be responsible for architectural integrity and scalability of fulfillment systems by (1) identifying interface contracts with partner tech teams (2) making the architecture more nimble and self-serve for faster time-to-market of new capabilities (3) improving resiliency and availability of Tier-1 systems (4) optimizing the level of service orchestration within the fulfillment systems.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Architect the joint FM-MM optimization loop: state-passing contracts, convergence detection, parallel execution, and checkpoint/restart
* Solve computational tractability through smart pruning, lightweight solvers, and metaheuristic search at network scale
* Drive cross-org alignment across 5+ organizations — securing stable interfaces and committed roadmap items
* Translate optimization outputs into actionable recommendations for Operations (node mapping, capacity), Commercial (shipper targets, geographies), and Finance (cost-to-serve, contract economics)
* Mentor a team of Applied Scientists and SDEs; set technical bar and build experimentation culture
* Define and execute the phased roadmap: FM cost optimizer (Phase 1) → joint FM-MM optimizer (Phase 2) → decision engines that close the loop from network optimization to commercial strategy (Phase 3)
* Own system validation and accuracy: design feedback loops from actual vs. predicted outcomes, detect degradation, and define refresh cadence

**Basic Qualifications**

* 12+ years of software development with increasing scope; 7+ years in system architecture
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problem spaces — where requirements, success metrics, and solution approach are all undefined — and drive them to concrete technical strategy and execution
* Experience communicating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership to collect requirements, describe technical designs, and align on product strategy
* Track record of influencing technical direction across 5+ partner organizations without direct authority
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and scientists
* Experience building decision-support systems adopted by non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* M.S./Ph.D. in Operations Research, CS, Applied Math, or related field
* Expertise in logistics optimization: vehicle routing, network design, or supply chain planning at scale
* Deep expertise in optimization systems, operations research, or simulation — building production systems that solve combinatorial optimization or search problems
* Experience with iterative optimization or metaheuristic frameworks in production

Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer.
